verdict.rationale: Auth0 supports headless/CI-friendly automation via the Client Credentials (M2M) flow for machine-to-machine auth, an official CLI (auth0-cli) for managing tenant config and automating tasks, and Management/Authentication APIs suitable for scripted use. However, evidence doesn't show CI-specific guides, service-account key rotation patterns, or non-interactive testing/staging workflows tailored for CI pipelines. missing for 10: CI-specific documentation/examples, headless testing guidance, evidence of CI pipeline integration patterns.
